operations.description: Generates the next assistant message from a conversation. This API is only supported for Unified Endpoints via Gateway. Please refer to the Anthropic Messages API Spec for more information. [https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/go/beta/messages/create](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/go/beta/messages/create)
